notes: Gen 1: Ditto transforms into a level-7 Zubat; behind Ditto's Substitute, Zubat's critical Mega Drain (Grass at 0.25× on Poison / Flying) comes to 0 damage. pokered's `AdjustDamageForMoveType` makes such a move miss (`wMoveMissed`): the Substitute keeps its 75 HP and Zubat drains nothing. Showdown's gen1 Substitute took the 0 as a hit and drained 1; recorded under the oracle's patch (issues.md I221, R-M11-107; cloud Nightly 42452722117, m9-gen1ou-s102800-014)
